channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Tanzania: Sahan macdan oo cusub oo lagu sameynayo diyaaradaha drone-ka iyo diyaarado hooseeya
item.description: Hay'adda Sahanka Juqraafiga ee Tanzania (GST) ayaa si rasmi ah u bilowday barnaamij sahan macdan oo casri ah oo adeegsanaya drone-yo gaar ah iyo diyaarado si hoose u duula, iyadoo Wasiirka Macdanta Anthony Mavunde uu ku dhawaaqay Mirerani, halkaas oo lagu ogaanayo baaxadda suunka dhagaxa tanzanite-ka, sida uu wariyay Daily News (wargeys dowladeed).

item.title: Kenya: Murkomen oo saaxiibada caalamka u ballanqaaday doorasho nabadeed 2027
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Kenya Kipchumba Murkomen ayaa Isniintii kulan uu Nairobi kula yeeshay madaxda ergada Kooxda Deeq-bixiyeyaasha Qaxootiga iyo saaxiibo kale ku sheegay in Kenya ay si buuxda ugu diyaargaroobayso doorasho nabadeed oo 2027 dhacda, isla markaana Adeegga Booliska Qaranka uu xoojinayo diyaargarowgiisa wejiyada doorashada oo dhan, sida uu wariyay KBC (warbaahinta dowladda).

item.title: Kenya: Mudavadi oo dalbaday in dallacsiinta shaqaalaha dowladda lagu xiro waxqabadka
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirrada Kenya Musalia Mudavadi ayaa ku baaqay sharci isku xira waxqabadka iyo wax-soo-saarka shaqaalaha dowladda iyo dallacsiintooda, isagoo sheegay in heshiisyada waxqabadka aysan noqon karin caado keliya ee ay noqdaan waajib sharci, sida uu wariyay KBC (warbaahinta dowladda).

item.title: Finnair: Xog ka dhac ka dhacay nidaamka Amadeus oo saameyn kara 116,000 ballan duulimaad
item.description: Shirkadda diyaaradaha Finland ee Finnair ayaa sheegtay in xog ka dhac ka dhacay nidaamka caalamiga ah ee ballansashada Amadeus uu saameyn karo ilaa 116,000 ballan duulimaad oo macaamiisheeda ah, sida uu wariyay Sweden Herald.

item.title: Ingiriiska: Russell Brand oo lagu xukumay 10 sano iyo 6 bilood oo xabsi ah
item.description: Maxkamadda Southwark Crown Court ee London ayaa Isniintii jilaaga iyo majaajiliistaha Ingiriiska Russell Brand ku xukuntay 10 sano iyo 6 bilood oo xabsi ah, kadib markii toddobaadkii hore lagu helay dembiyo kufsi iyo faraxumeyn galmo oo loo geystay 4 haween intii u dhaxeysay 2004 iyo 2009. Brand wuxuu sheegay inuu dembi la'aan yahay, sida ay wariyeen France 24 iyo Al Jazeera.

item.title: Tanzania: Nin looga shakiyay inuu hoggaamiyo shabakad daroogo oo lagu qabtay Kenya
item.description: Hay'adda La-dagaallanka Daroogada ee Tanzania (DCEA) ayaa sheegtay in hawlgal wadajir ah oo ay la sameysay hay'adaha Kenya lagu qabtay Saleh Khamis Baseleman oo loo yaqaan Mbwiga, oo ah muwaadin Tanzaniyaan ah oo ku nool Mombasa, kana mid ah 7 qof oo la xiray. Waxaa lagu eedeeyay inuu daroogo ka keeni jiray Afgaanistaan, badda uga soo gudbin jiray xeebta Mombasa, kana qaybin jiray dalal ay Tanzania ka mid tahay, sida ay werisay The Citizen.

item.title: Google oo soo bandhigtay laba nooc oo cusub oo chip-ka AI ah si ay ula tartanto Nvidia
item.description: Shirkadda Google, oo ka tirsan kooxda Alphabet, ayaa soo bandhigtay laba nooc oo cusub oo ah chip-yada sirdoonka macmalka ah ee loo yaqaan TPU (tensor processing units), iyadoo ballaarinaysa tartankeeda ay kula jirto Nvidia, sida uu wariyay Sweden Herald.

item.title: Kenya: Sakaja oo Senate-ka u sharxay hoos u dhaca Sh43.73 bilyan ee deymaha Nairobi
item.description: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Nairobi Johnson Sakaja ayaa Guddiga Xisaabaadka Dowladaha Hoose ee Senate-ka u sheegay in deymaha aan la bixin ee magaalada laga dhimay Sh118.79 bilyan ilaa Sh75.07 bilyan, isagoo sheegay in hoos u dhaca Sh43.73 bilyan aan lagu gaarin lacag-bixin keliya ee ay ku jiraan qiimeyn sharci, go'aanno maxkamadeed iyo hubinta sheegashooyin lagu muransan yahay, sida ay werisay The Standard.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Haweenka Bariga Equatoria oo dalbaday taageero lagu xoojiyo nabadda
item.description: Kooxaha haweenka ee gobolka Bariga Equatoria, oo ay ku jiraan dhaqdhaqaaqa Mothers' Voice for Peace iyo ururo ka hawlgala degmooyinka Budi, Kapoeta East, Torit iyo Ikotos, ayaa dowladda iyo deeq-bixiyeyaasha ka dalbaday taageero dheeraad ah oo lagu wajaho amni darrada laguna xoojiyo nabadda, sida uu wariyay Eye Radio.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Galbeedka Equatoria oo tababar u furtay saraakiisha doorashada
item.description: Guddoomiyaha ku-meelgaarka ah ee gobolka Galbeedka Equatoria, Badagbu Daniel Rimbasa, ayaa magaalada Yambio ka furay tababar 2 maalmood ah oo loogu talagalay saraakiisha soo celinta doorashada iyo kaaliyayaashooda, si loogu diyaargaroobo doorashooyinka soo socda, sida ay wariyeen Radio Tamazuj iyo Eye Radio.

item.title: Danjiraha Türkiye Ferhat Alkan oo kulan la qaatay Madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo
item.description: Danjiraha Türkiye u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan isbarasho ah la yeeshay Madaxweynihii 9-aad ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Maxamed Farmaajo. Labada dhinac waxay ka wada hadleen xaaladda Soomaaliya, xiriirka Türkiye iyo Soomaaliya iyo arrimaha gobolka iyo caalamka, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Safaaradda Türkiye.

item.title: FIFPro: 5 ciyaartoy Isbaanish ah oo ku jira kooxda ugu fiican adduunka ee haweenka 2026
item.description: Ururka ciyaartoyda xirfadlayaasha ah ee FIFPro ayaa shaaciyay FIFPro World 11 ee haweenka 2026, oo ay codeeyeen 6511 ciyaartoy xirfadlayaal ah oo ka kala socda 64 waddan; waxaa ku jira Irene Paredes, Mapi León, Aitana Bonmatí, Alexia Putellas iyo Claudia Pina, sida ay wariyeen AS iyo Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Faransiiska: Lecornu oo hore u soo dhigay kororka 1.6% ee mushaharka ugu yar
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Faransiiska Sébastien Lecornu ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay in kororka 1.6% ee mushaharka ugu yar oo loo qorsheeyay Janaayo la hormarinayo oo la dhaqangelinayo Diseembar, kadib wadahadallo uu la yeeshay ururada shaqaalaha iyo ganacsatada, iyadoo dalku wajahayo mudaaharaadyo ka dhan ah qaalinnimada nolosha; ururadu waxay sheegeen in kororku aanu gaarin dalabaadkooda, sida ay wariyay France 24.

item.title: NFL: Jacksonville Jaguars oo Atlanta Falcons kala soo wareegay Jessie Bates III
item.description: Kooxda Jacksonville Jaguars ayaa ka hor waqtiga kama dambaysta ah ee iibka NFL ee Talaadada heshiis la gaartay Atlanta Falcons si ay u hesho difaaca All-Pro-ga ah Jessie Bates III, iyadoo Falcons ay helayaan doorashada wareegga 2 ee 2027 iyo wareegga 5 ee 2028, sida ay wariyay CBS Sports oo xiganaya ESPN.

item.title: Kenya: Victor Wanyama oo kabtan u noqonaya halyeeyada Harambee Stars ee wajahaya Arsenal
item.description: Kabtankii hore ee Harambee Stars Victor Wanyama ayaa hoggaamin doona halyeeyada xulka Kenya ee la ciyaaraya halyeeyada Arsenal tartanka Legends Cup oo Jimcaha ka dhacaya garoonka Nyayo, isagoo ay la socdaan MacDonald Mariga iyo Dennis Oliech, sida ay wariyay Capital FM.

item.title: Kremlin-ka oo diiday in Yurub ka qayb gasho wadahadallada Abu Dhabi
item.description: Afhayeenka Kremlin-ka Dmitry Peskov ayaa Isniintii sheegay in kulanka nabadda ee toddobaadkan lagu qaban doono Abu Dhabi, oo ay ka qayb gelayaan wakiillo Ukraine iyo Mareykan ah, aanay ka qayb geli doonin saraakiil Midowga Yurub, isagoo xusay in Mareykanka iyo Ukraine ay leeyihiin kanaallo ay kula xiriiraan reer Yurub, sida ay wariyay The Moscow Times.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Booliska Yei oo xiray nin looga shakisan yahay dilka arday dugsi sare
item.description: Booliska degmada Yei River ayaa xiray nin looga shakisan yahay dilka Henry Dengero, oo ahaa arday fasalka Senior 2 ee dugsiga Yei Day Secondary School, kaas oo la sheegay in burcad ay toogteen kadibna mootadiisa kala dhaceen habeennimadii Jimcaha, sida uu sheegay kormeeraha booliska degmada Yoasa Lujang Kamba, sida uu wariyay Eye Radio.

item.title: Uganda: Wasiir Justine Lumumba oo ku baaqday in tiknoolajiyadda la gaarsiiyo miyiga
item.description: Wasiirka ICT-ga iyo Hanuuninta Qaranka ee Uganda, Justine Lumumba, ayaa Sabtidii booqatay mashruuca Tuulada Casriga ah ee Buhadyo ee degmada Butaleja, waxayna ku baaqday in bulshooyinka miyiga ay si ballaaran u qaataan tiknoolajiyadda si loo yareeyo farqiga dijitaalka, sida uu wariyay Nile Post.

item.title: Kenya: Ronald Karauri oo ku biiray UDA si uu ula tartamo Sakaja xilka guddoomiyaha Nairobi
item.description: Xildhibaanka Kasarani Ronald Karauri ayaa si rasmi ah ugu biiray xisbiga talada haya ee UDA si uu ugu tartamo xilka guddoomiyaha gobolka Nairobi doorashada 2027, sida ay werisay Capital FM. Arrintan ayaa timid maalmo kadib markii Guddoomiye Johnson Sakaja uu UDA uga wareegay xisbiga ODM.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in nacaybka Israa'iil uu ka mid ahaa sababaha Jamhuuriyiinta looga adkaaday
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa wareysi uu siiyay barnaamijka "60 Minutes" ee CBS ku sheegay in dagaalka Iran, kororka qiimaha shidaalka iyo nacayb loo qabo Israa'iil ay ka mid ahaayeen sababaha Jamhuuriyiintu uga guuldarreysteen doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Alisson oo sheegay in uu doonayo in uu sii joogo Liverpool
item.description: Goolhayaha Liverpool Alisson, oo heshiiskiisu dhamaanayo dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan, ayaa sheegay in rabitaankiisu yahay in uu sii joogo Anfield, kadib guushii 3-1 ee Axaddii ay ka gaareen Crystal Palace, sida ay werisay Sky Sports.

item.title: Uganda: Bangiga Dhexe oo heerka dulsaarka ku sii hayay 12%
item.description: Bangiga Dhexe ee Uganda ayaa heerka dulsaarka ee CBR ku sii hayay 12%, isagoo ka digay in qiimaha tamarta, hoos u dhaca shilinka iyo cimilada xun ay sare u qaadi karaan sicir bararka, sida uu sheegay Guddoomiyaha bangiga Michael Atingi-Ego. Bangiga ayaa sidoo kale ballaariyay xadka CBR oo laga dhigay 3 dhibcood oo boqolley ah.

item.title: Kenya: Ruto oo ku jees jeesay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ee sheeganaya malaayiin cod
item.description: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa su'aal geliyay sheegashada Rigathi Gachagua, Kalonzo Musyoka iyo Fred Matiang'i ee ah in ay haystaan malaayiin cod, kadib kulan ay toddobaadkan ku yeesheen Nairobi oo ku saabsanaa doorashada 2027, sida ay werisay Capital FM. Ruto ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay socdaal uu ku marayay gobolka Gusii.

item.title: Giriigga: Ugu yaraan 21 muhaajiriin ah oo ku dhintay isku day ay ku doonayeen gaarista Crete
item.description: Ilaalada xeebaha Giriigga ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 21 qof ay ku dhinteen isku day ay ku doonayeen in ay gaaraan jasiiradda Crete, halka in ka badan 100 qof lagu badbaadiyay hawlgallo dhowr ah oo koonfurta jasiiradda ka dhacay, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Xasan Cali Khayre oo laba sarkaal ku eedeeyay dil iyo dhulboob ka dhacay xaafadda Raadeerka ee Deyniile
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre, ayaa bartiisa Facebook ku cambaareeyay waxa uu ugu yeeray xasuuq, dhulboob iyo barakicin ka socda xaafadda Raadeerka ee degmada Deyniile, wuxuuna eedda dusha uga tuuray laba sarkaal oo uu magacaabay. Saraakiisha iyo dowladda midkoodna weli kama jawaabin eedeymahan.

item.title: Cricket: England oo Brydon Carse u furtay dib u soo laabasho, Shoaib Bashir-na ka reebtay
item.description: England ayaa ciyaartoyga Brydon Carse ku dartay kooxda Lions, taasoo u furaysa inuu ku soo laabto Test-ka safarka Koonfur Afrika, halka 15-ka ciyaartoy ee taxanaha 3-da Test ee ka bilaabanaya Johannesburg 17-ka Diseembar uu Liam Patterson-White ku beddelay Shoaib Bashir, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Kenya: Murkomen oo ugu baaqay Sifuna inuu taageero Ruto, kuna ballanqaaday hoggaanka 2032
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Kenya, Kipchumba Murkomen, ayaa ugu baaqay Senatarka Nairobi Edwin Sifuna inuu ka tanaasulo hamigiisa madaxweyne ee doorashada 2027 oo uu garab istaago Madaxweyne William Ruto, isagoo sheegay in bulshada Luhya ay sidaas ku heli karto hoggaanka dalka sannadka 2032, sida ay werisay Capital FM.

item.title: Pierre Kalulu oo dhaawac darteed seegi doona kulamada Faransiiska ee Nations League
item.description: Baaritaanno lagu sameeyay kadib kulankii Juventus iyo Fiorentina ayaa muujiyay in daafaca Pierre Kalulu uu dhaawac muruq ah ka gaaray lugta bidix, sidaas darteed ma ka qayb gali doono kulamada Faransiiska ee Talyaaniga iyo Turkiga, sida ay wariyeen La Gazzetta dello Sport iyo L'Équipe.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Jen. Joseph Lagu waxaa lagu aasi doonaa xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee Juba
item.description: Guddiga qabanqaabada aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu Yanga, hoggaamiyihii dhaqdhaqaaqa Anyanya One, ayaa u sheegay Eye Radio in lagu aasi doono gudaha xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee magaalada Juba, kadib markii Madaxweyne Salva Kiir go'aamiyay in loo sameeyo aas qaran.

item.title: Halyeeyga judo-da Teddy Riner oo u tartamaya madaxweynaha Faransiiska 2027
item.description: Teddy Riner, oo 5 jeer ku guuleystay bilad dahab ah oo Olombikada ah, ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay inuu u tartami doono doorashada madaxweynaha Faransiiska ee sannadka 2027, sida ay werisay France 24.
